title: Te Waiata i Neke ai ngā Maunga
intro: Kei te tata koe ki te hura i te kōrero mō tētahi pononga whakamiharo a Allah. I te whenua o ngā karere me ngā rangatira, i manaakitia tēnei tangata ki tētahi pukapuka atua, he reo kaha, ā, he kaha ake i te rino. I a koe e pānui ana i ngā tohu, ka taea e koe te tautuhi ko wai tēnei?
clues: He pononga ahau nā Allah i homai he pukapuka motuhake ki ahau.
He reo ataahua tōku, ā, i tino arohaina ahau e te whakamoemiti, ā, i aru mai ngā pukepuke me ngā manu ki ahau.
I tūtaki ahau ki tētahi hoa whawhai kaha rawa i roto i tētahi pakanga rongonui, ā, ahakoa he iti ahau, i toa ahau.
I hangaia te rino kia ngāwari mōku, kia taea ai e au te hanga pukupuku ki ōku ake ringaringa.
I meinga ahau hei rangatira mō tētahi iwi nui, ā, i rongonuitia tōku whakaaro nui ki te whakarite.
Ko taku tama, he poropiti anō hoki, i tukuna ki a ia te mana whakahaere i te hau me ngā jinn.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: I maka ki roto i te ahi

outcome.label: Hua
options: I riro hei poropiti, hei kingi hoki mō Iharaira
I riro hei rangatira mō Īhipa
I noho hei hoa mō te ana
outcome.answer: I riro hei poropiti, hei kingi hoki mō Iharaira

arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise. (38:18)
